name: Feature Enhance
description: Search becomes four category tiles with real paging on Jellyfin's own list page (native sort menu and filters work); path and folder-name search; folder results can play or shuffle the files inside them; a 3x3 contact-sheet preview for video cards; flicker-free navigation.
overview:
A client-side quality-of-life pack for the stock web client - injected at request time, no file inside the container is patched.

1) Search: the stock search page has no pagination at all - one limit=800 response builds 900+ cards at once, and folders are hard-coded out of its result types. A search now renders four category tiles (videos / images / albums / folders), each with its own real total. Clicking a tile opens Jellyfin's own list page with the native grid, pager, sort menu and filter menu; the plugin bridges its data so the total is the true count (not limit x 3) and deep paging works. Sort keys and filters are translated server-side by Jellyfin's own query builder, and the stock search requests are answered locally, so a search no longer fetches 800 items or builds 900 cards.

2) Search by file path and folder name: matches paths and folder names as well as titles, tolerates typos in folder names, and makes folders searchable at all. Folder results can play or shuffle the files inside them.

3) Video preview: a small eye button on every video card opens a 3x3 contact sheet of nine frames sampled at 10%, 20% ... 90% of the runtime. Every cell is a complete frame (landscape frames are rotated inside their cell, nothing is cropped), duration and file size are burned in, and generation uses Jellyfin's own hardware acceleration arguments - so it follows Dashboard / Playback / Transcoding automatically.

4) Navigation: opening an item or going back used to leave the content area blank for 2-3 frames (100-150 ms) before the cards were rebuilt. The outgoing page is now frozen into an overlay and cross-faded out once the new page has painted.

Everything lives under config/data/plugins, so Jellyfin upgrades and container rebuilds do not break it. Requires Jellyfin 12.0.x.
